Subject: ONE massive coherent ancient jungle canyon rock buttress, roughly 8 metres wide, 16 metres tall, 7 metres deep. Very broad solid rooted flared bottom, three immense interlocking sculpted ochre sandstone masses, a narrower uneven crown with two natural horizontal planting shelves. Deep cool umber crevices, softly rounded broken faces, tapered asymmetrical silhouette, rich golden tan planes, muted terracotta sediment, small restrained patches of olive moss in the shelf corners. Thick connected rock all the way from bottom to crown, no hole through the mass. Each of the three masses is substantial, not many thin stacked pancakes. Geometry must look believable as a cliff supporting temples and trees. No plants or architectural pieces, no standalone ground disc.
